en: Vintage sepia postcard showing an enormous crowd of soldiers and civilians gathered on an open square or parade ground. Many men are in uniform with rifles, flags are raised in the center, and a lamp post and distant low hills are visible in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom describe the proclamation of the annexation of Crete to Greece and the oath of the militia in the name of the King of Greece. The publisher's line indicates it was edited by a photographer in Canea (Chania), Crete.
